listings.rawTitle: Marwa Perfume 100ml EDP Arabiyat Prestige 100ml
listings.description: Marwa Perfume 100ml EDP Arabiyat Prestige is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. People with good taste who like the fine beauty of oriental perfumes with a modern twist will love this lovely scent. The smell of Marwa is smooth and rich, and it will draw you in. It's nice enough to wear during the day or at night. You'll have a smooth ride from a bright beginning to a deeply moving woody-amber track thanks to its well-balanced structure. . Specifications . Suitable for: Men . Brand: Arabiyat Prestige . Fragrance Type: Citrus Aromatic fragrance . Size: 100ml . Speciality: Long-lasting perfume . Fragrance Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot, Petit Grain, Ginger . Middle Notes: Geranium, Tea, Incense . Base Notes: Guaiacwood, Ambroxan, Musk . Calabrian bergamot, lemon, and Sicilian orange make up the first part of Marwa. This gives the scent a sense of fresh energy and Mediterranean weather. This lively beginning wakes up the senses and sets the stage for a sophisticated trip through the senses. . There is a soft mix of Tunisian neroli, Nigerian ginger, and Ceylon cinnamon in the heart as the first brightness fades. With ginger and cinnamon, there is just the right amount of mystery and depth. Neroli adds warmth and charm. This is where flowery class meets flowery spice. . Marwa finally lands on a base made up of Chinese black tea, ambroxan, olibanum (frankincense), and guaiac wood. This base has a lot of different textures. This layer lasts a long time and has a beautiful, resonant end. It has the smoky appeal of black tea, the sensual amber of ambroxan, the mysterious resinous note of frankincense, and the grounding, woody warmth of guaiac wood. . Why Choose Marwa Perfume for Men? . A radiant opening that captivates with Mediterranean-inspired freshness . A heart that skillfully blends floral elegance with intriguing spice . A base that delivers depth, longevity, and a sophisticated woody warmth . Impeccably suited for both daytime refinement and evening seduction . If you want options, you can visit our men’s fragrance collection ! .
